caption:
The sun drops behind the headland and the clouds catch fire above us. Only the rail in the corner tells you we are on the water.
No engine noise at this point. We cut it and just sit.
Five people at most on board, so everyone gets a front row.
O sol a tocar o mar.
Details and dates on chifbay.com
